resolved_conflicts.explanation: All three sources date a new cab to 1968 but disagree on its construction: a 2-story concrete frame cab (firelookout.com), a two-story frame cab on a concrete base (Idaho Fire Lookouts), and a cab built atop a cinder-block first story (Forest Lookouts). The story reports all three.

notes_for_editor: The sources disagree on the base of the 1968 cab; the story reports all three versions and does not choose one. The 1990 removal date comes from two sources; Forest Lookouts says only Removed. The 1932 and 1938 staff names come from a single Idaho Fire Lookouts page citing The Idaho Statesman; the Statesman itself was not read. The 1932 entry also names a child, which the story and research file leave out. Staffing status is not given as a fact because no source says whether the site is staffed today. No source describes the summit today. Used 1 search and about 5 page reads. Checked 2026-10-10: the cabin is now placed at the lookout site, since no source says it was on the summit; the cab base is reported as the sources differ on construction. The Idaho Statesman itself was not read.
